title: Payment-Channel Charges on Returned Kestrel Auto Finance Payments
content:
A payment-channel charge on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts follows the channel of the returned payment as its return entry shows it, the latest return entry on the loan history deciding, and is added to the returned-payment fee as a flat dollar amount.

| Channel of the returned payment | Payment-channel charge |
|---|---|
| online bank transfer (one-time) | electronic return charge: 2.00 |
| online debit card (one-time) | electronic return charge: 2.00 |
| representative-assisted bank transfer by phone | electronic return charge: 2.00 |
| representative-assisted debit card by phone | electronic return charge: 2.00 |
| mailed check | paper return charge: 5.00 |
| MoneyGram payment | paper return charge: 5.00 |
| autopay draft | no charge |

## Reading the channel

- The channel is the one recorded on the return entry, not the channel the borrower says was used.
- Hypothetical: a returned mailed check adds 5.00; a returned autopay draft adds nothing; a returned one-time debit card payment made online adds 2.00.
- Hypothetical: a fee of 42.50 before this charge, for a returned online bank transfer, comes to 44.50.
